summary: Crash on "Saving world" when F3 L profiling is active - java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot read field "f" because "this.D" is null
description: Steps to reproduce: 1. Start Minecraft. 2. Create a new world or join a world. 3. Press F3 L. 4. Before the 10 seconds are up, exit the world by pressing Escape then clicking "Save and Quit to Title". 5. Notice the resulting crash.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Start Minecraft.
2. Create a new world or join an existing one.
3. Press F3 L to activate profiling.
4. Before the 10 seconds are up, press Escape to open the main menu.
5. Click "Save and Quit to Title" in the main menu.
6. Notice the resulting crash when attempting to save the world.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.17.1, 21w37a, 21w38a, 21w40a, 21w41a, 1.18 Pre-release 1, 1.18.1, 22w03a, 22w06a, 1.18.2 Pre-release 1, 1.18.2 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: When attempting to save the world while F3 L profiling is active, Minecraft crashes with a `java.lang.NullPointerException` indicating that the field "f" cannot be read because "this.D" is null. To reproduce this issue, start Minecraft and create or join any world. Press F3 L to activate the profiling mode. Before the 10 seconds of profiling elapse, exit the world by pressing Escape and then clicking “Save and Quit to Title.” Upon attempting to save the world during this process, the game will crash. This behavior consistently results in a crash report that can be found in the `crash-reports` folder within the `.minecraft` directory. Additionally, capturing screenshots and compressing the `debug` folder into a ZIP file would provide further diagnostic information for developers.
Expected Behavior: When F3 L profiling is active, exiting the world by pressing Escape and clicking "Save and Quit to Title" should not cause a crash. The game should save the world normally without any exceptions or errors, allowing the player to return to the main menu safely.
